get.summary: Version and the AGPL §5d notice, which the footer shows.

post.summary: Explicit confirmation of reading. Never inferred from a page view.

delete.summary: Returns the instance to v0 behaviour: no AI affordance anywhere.

put.summary: Every field is optional; an omitted one is left as it was.

post.summary: Answers from permission-filtered passages, citing only sources the caller may read.

get.summary: Always present. Reports enabled:false when no provider is configured.

post.summary: Writes the sibling page badged machine-translated. The badge clears on a human save.

get.summary: Source diff for the admin, and a block-level rendered diff for everyone else.
The guide's table of contents, filtered to what this person can act on.
Unread badge. Filtered by the same permission re-check as the list.

post.summary: Ticks a checklist item from read mode. A byte substitution, not a re-serialization.

put.summary: Sets owner, review interval, next review date and whether acknowledgment is required.

post.summary: Resets the review clock. The only thing that does — an ordinary edit does not.
Changes a page's title in front matter, leaving the body and the file name unchanged.

get.summary: Reads a page, its rendered HTML and its metadata.

put.summary: Saves a page. The expected hash is required; a mismatch is a 409 carrying both versions.

get.summary: The navigation tree, filtered by the evaluator. Nodes at 'none' are absent, not greyed out.
Active accounts as id, username and display name — nothing else.

post.summary: Restores by writing a new version, so a mistaken restore is itself undoable.
